name: Lynn Woods main lot, Great Woods Road entrance (free)
basis: MP Getting There: two main lots, Great Woods Road (P01, reached via Rt 129 and Great Woods Rd) is closest to most climbing (Fenway, Stone Tower, Mt Spickett, Golf Course, Steel Tower, Overlook, Weetamoo); City of Lynn page lists Great Woods Rd entrance. Mapped lot w75140141 is the only unrestricted free lot at the eastern edge of the reservation, ~0.2 km from the Fenway/Parking Lot boulders; matched by position.
